summary: Removed speaker attribution from model-authored message text and preserved it as structured transcript metadata.
Proved that a message without an @handle follows the host-chat path, receives no attribution, and never writes back to the previously mentioned source chat.
Added an idempotent repair for legacy un-attributed assistant messages that copied a reserved attribution prefix from a structurally attributed ancestor.
Made debug builds use a separate prompt-free, explicitly non-secure development store; release builds retain the Keychain-backed secure store.
Built and launched the macOS debug bundle with the local SmolLM2 GGUF, then visually exercised an attributed live-chat mention followed by an ordinary host response.

tests_run.detail: All deterministic workspace tests passed, including direct host follow-up/source isolation and legacy attribution repair.

tests_run.command: cargo test -p mom-llama-app && cargo clippy -p mom-llama-app --all-targets -- -D warnings

tests_run.detail: Exact Persona catalog and product UX passed; inference remains in-process; 81 commands, 90 affordances, 25 effects, 36 parity rows, 58 settings, zero blockers.

tests_run.command: Computer Use: live mention followed by an unmentioned host reply
tests_run.detail: The mentioned response rendered one stored source byline. The following ordinary response rendered without a byline or inline attribution prefix.
Host had four messages with null final attribution and zero inline attribution prefixes; source remained at two messages.
